content: schema.org Game type is a real, purpose-built type for physical/board games (distinct from VideoGame) with audience/suggested-age and description support; more semantically correct than generic Product for a non-commerce catalog (this app doesn't sell games, so Product/offers/price fields don't apply cleanly). ItemList is the appropriate wrapper for the catalog/browse page (an ordered/unordered list of Game items with url+position), while each detail page gets its own Game object. Product schema is best avoided here since it implies commerce (price, availability, reviews-for-purchase) that doesn't match a club-owned physical copy with no online purchase path.
